title: Harmonic Lock
statementMarkdown:
Ten calibration rotors fire on cycles of **1, 2, 3, …, 10** seconds. The harmonic lock opens on the first beat at which **every rotor fires together**.

**Which beat opens the lock?**
hints: Build it up: lcm of 1–5 first, then fold in 6 through 10.
The rotor on a 7-second cycle forces the answer to be a multiple of 7.
